what: two bodies whose STL export used to have open edges where faces were meshed apart: a 40x30x20 box with all twelve edges rounded 2 mm, and a cylinder R15 x 20 with a coaxial 6 mm bore
method: Rounded box: Steiner formula for the box 36x26x16 grown by a ball of r=2 (equal rounds on all twelve edges meet in spherical corners): V = xyz + 2r(xy+yz+zx) + pi r^2 (x+y+z) + 4/3 pi r^3 = 23701.687, A = 2(xy+yz+zx) + 2 pi r (x+y+z) + 4 pi r^2 = 4886.442; 26 faces (6 planes, 12 cylinders, 8 sphere corners). Drilled cylinder: V = pi (15^2-3^2) 20 = 13571.680, A = 2 pi (15^2-3^2) + 2 pi 15 20 + 2 pi 3 20 = 1152 pi = 3619.115; 4 faces. Totals over both bodies. A watertight STL (every edge shared by two triangles) is not graded by the rig.
